The '''MSS-C-342A''' was pre-selected group of [[Corporate-class modular unit|''Corporate''-class modular units]] chosen by [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]] to be used in hard [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] or harsh environments. It came equipped with living quarters, laboratories, storage, and command units.<ref name="H&S" />
